abstract: Recent clinical management of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis is reviewed. This illness is required the management of the neurological emergency. Typical symptoms of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis develop in several stages that progresses from psychosis, memory deficits, seizures, and language disintegration into a state of unresponsiveness with catatonic features often associated with abnormal movements, and autonomic and respiratory instability. The diagnosis is depended on the detection of the NMDA receptor antibody in CSF or serum under the above characteristic symptoms of encephalitis. The disorder predominantly affects children and young adults, occurs with or without tumor association. The presence of a tumor (usually an ovarian teratoma) is dependent on age and sex, being more frequent in women older than 18 years. Anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis should be treated with tumor resection and immunotherapy (corticosteroids, intravenous immunoglobulin, or plasma exchange) responded faster to treatment and less frequently needed second-line immunotherapy (cyclophosphamide or rituximab, or both).
abstract_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の最近の臨床的管理を概説する。本疾患は神経学的救急の管理を必要とする。抗NMDA受容体脳炎の典型的な症状は、精神病、記憶障害、けいれん、言語の崩壊から、異常運動や自律神経・呼吸の不安定を伴う緘静様の無反応状態へと、いくつかの段階を経て進行する。診断は、上記の典型的な脳炎症状を伴う髄液または血清中のNMDA受容体抗体の検出に依存する。本疾患は主に小児および若年成人に生じ、腫瘍の有無を問わず発症する。腫瘍の存在(通常は卵巣奇形腫)は年齢と性別に依存し、18歳以上の女性でより多い。抗NMDA受容体脳炎は腫瘍の外科的切除と免疫療法(ステロイド、静注免疫グロブリン、または血漿交換)で治療すべきである。免疫療法への反応は速く、第二選択の免疫療法(シクロホスファミドまたはリツキシマブ、もしくは両方)を必要とすることは少ない。
